claims.claim: A Government Gateway account is needed to apply.
claims.quote: a Government Gateway account - if you do not already have one, you can set one up by using this service
claims.note: Only a single council page names a Government Gateway account; the GOV.UK list of what you need to apply does not include it and only mentions a user ID and password for signing in.

claims.quote: Before you apply, you’ll need to check with your provider that they’re already signed up.
claims.note: The text says to check your provider is signed up before applying, but childcare provider details are not in the list of what you need to apply.
